<a id="open-cells-take-one"></a>

## Open cells: take one

An open cell is a mechanism and a property where the mechanism's own documentation, or the text that defines it, says it cannot establish the property. Start with these:

1.  **Declarative policy decision point (OPA, Cedar, OpenFGA, Kyverno) x Effect** (did the downstream system commit the effect?). Limit: "a decision precedes execution and cannot observe the result" [source](https://github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/blob/a6c13a96f0cd11dc7ca6db9296b2af842ffdc0fd/README.md) (states the scope). Take it: a passing case binds an allow decision to an effect observed from a vantage the decider does not control.
2.  **Signature over a canonical JSON or CWT record (RFC 8785 JCS, JWS) x Occurrence** (did the recorded event actually happen, rather than being asserted?). Limit: "TRACE LIMITATIONS: a privileged operator can produce a valid-looking Level 0 record for a run that never happened" [source](https://github.com/agentrust-io/trace-spec/blob/5222ed4e238627590fb21e801e0acdf7c9d78cbc/LIMITATIONS.md) (states the limit). Take it: a passing case refuses a well-signed record with no independent observation of the run.

To take a cell, [open an Evidence run issue](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-atlas/issues/new?template=evidence-run.yml) naming it. Listing a cell makes no claim about who closes it; a run that does is recorded in the Lab like any other.

<a id="every-open-cell-29"></a>

## Every open cell (29)

The 2 cells above, then the rest. Each limit is the Atlas's wording; "states the limit" means the source page says it, and "states the scope" means the page states the function the limit bounds.

| mechanism | property | limit, in the Atlas's words | source |
|----|----|----|----|
| Hash-chained audit log held by the writer | Effect | "AGT LIMITATIONS: an audit trail of actions, not an audit trail of outcomes" | [source](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit/blob/6b644564d112b879e48183bc1655fcf73c86d23e/docs/LIMITATIONS.md) (states the limit) |
| In-process interception hook in the agent framework | Effect | "AGT states its audit trail records what the agent attempted and does not verify that the action succeeded" | [source](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit/blob/6b644564d112b879e48183bc1655fcf73c86d23e/docs/LIMITATIONS.md) (states the limit) |
| Kernel event sensor on the host (eBPF: Tetragon, Falco) | Effect | "a syscall shows an attempt left the process, not that a remote system committed it" | [source](https://github.com/cilium/tetragon/blob/1911464de685034ca2ce49274a0fd983ac569b38/README.md) (states the scope) |
| OAuth delegated authorization and token exchange (on-behalf-of) | Effect | "a grant of scope is issued before the action and says nothing about the downstream commit" | [source](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8693.txt) (states the scope) |
| Out-of-process gateway or proxy mediating agent traffic | Event completeness | "Pipelock states its scorecard does not prove whether anything happened outside the boundary it mediates" | [source](https://github.com/luckyPipewrench/pipelock/blob/cf8a9a112c9ff58faa338d1bdb9e7c8c8a377abb/README.md) (states the limit) |
| In-process interception hook in the agent framework | Event completeness | "AGENT-HOOKS states its eight interception points do not guarantee complete mediation" | [source](https://github.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/blob/5d04b3b27efe1198d68c9e2df952804d8b4040be/README.md) (states the limit) |
| Mandatory serious-incident reporting to an authority | Event completeness | "reporting is triggered by the provider establishing a causal link, so an unestablished link produces no report" | [source](http://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/32024R1689) (states the limit) |
| Declarative policy decision point (OPA, Cedar, OpenFGA, Kyverno) | Event completeness | "a decision point sees only the queries routed to it; an action never submitted leaves no trace there" | [source](https://github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/blob/a6c13a96f0cd11dc7ca6db9296b2af842ffdc0fd/README.md) (states the scope) |
| SCITT transparency-service receipt (RFC 9942/9943) | Event completeness | "RFC 9943 section 9.3: issuers can submit some but not all of their statements" | [source](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9943.txt) (states the limit) |
| Event log written by the system it describes | Event completeness | "the writer decides which events are recorded; Article 12 lists purposes, not a closed event set" | [source](http://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/32024R1689) (states the limit) |
| Sandbox supervisor signing a Merkle root over its own log of mediated calls | Event completeness | "the log holds only the calls that reach the supervisor; opens covered by the initial capability set take a fast path that proceeds without a record" | [source](https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/blob/f45674332d763eeb168422c09e7a0e73416f014c/crates/nono-cli/src/exec_strategy/supervisor_linux.rs) (states the limit) |
| Benchmark or task-suite evaluation of an agent | Occurrence | "the Systemic Risk Index states it supports inspection of evidence and does not certify models or providers; a test result is not a record of a deployed run" | [source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.28335) (states the limit) |
| DSSE signature over the pre-authentication encoding of a typed payload | Occurrence | "a signature proves who signed the bytes, not that the signed statement is true" | [source](https://github.com/secure-systems-lab/dsse/blob/1d3370f62565bca041e97c8310b873ac340edc2e/README.md) (states the scope) |
| Per-request proof of possession (DPoP, WIMSE workload proof token) | Occurrence | "proves a key signed a request; the request being sent is not the action occurring" | [source](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9449.txt) (states the scope) |
| SCITT transparency-service receipt (RFC 9942/9943) | Occurrence | "RFC 9943 section 9.2: registering a statement only proves an issuer produced it" | [source](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9943.txt) (states the limit) |
| TEE remote attestation of launched code (RATS, SEV-SNP, TDX, GPU CC) | Occurrence | "TRACE LIMITATIONS: attestation proves the signing key and policy engine were measured before execution, which is not a record of what ran after" | [source](https://github.com/agentrust-io/trace-spec/blob/5222ed4e238627590fb21e801e0acdf7c9d78cbc/LIMITATIONS.md) (states the limit) |
| Append-only Merkle transparency log | Occurrence | "a log proves an entry was appended, not that its content is true" | [source](https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/blob/904bbccce4df5e63c30209d7b7a00d9dda5400d6/README.md) (states the scope) |
| Workload identity credential (SPIFFE SVID, WIMSE workload identity token) | Occurrence | "a credential says which workload holds a key, never what the workload did with it" | [source](https://github.com/spiffe/spiffe/blob/f97c46dfd0ff0d4e412cce5c73846a9ca32a99a2/README.md) (states the scope) |
| SCITT transparency-service receipt (RFC 9942/9943) | Ordering | "RFC 9943 section 9.1: registration order need not match issuance order unless the policy says so" | [source](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9943.txt) (states the limit) |
| Chain-of-thought monitoring | Reasoning fidelity | "a monitor reads the reasoning it is shown; METR notes closed-model developers do not disclose whether chains of thought were trained to look legible" | [source](https://metr.org/blog/2026-05-19-frontier-risk-report/) (states the limit) |
| Post-hoc transcript review, human or LLM-assisted | Reasoning fidelity | "AISI: model providers usually return a paraphrased summary rather than raw reasoning traces" | [source](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/663bd486c5e4c81588db7a1d/6a724858f7db25c81487016d_Security%20Incident%20INC-2026-07-28-01.pdf) (states the limit) |
| Application-kernel trace points streamed to a monitor outside the sandbox (gVisor runtime monitoring) | Vantage independence | "gVisor's own threat model: the Sentry is not trusted, and the monitor must validate and never trust input received from it" | [source](https://github.com/google/gvisor/blob/a97b4dd056998f835ee843c8ec2159b6633da2cf/pkg/sentry/seccheck/sinks/remote/README.md) (states the limit) |
| In-process interception hook in the agent framework | Vantage independence | "the hook executes inside the observed agent's process, so the observed party controls it" | [source](https://github.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/blob/5d04b3b27efe1198d68c9e2df952804d8b4040be/README.md) (states the limit) |
| Event log written by the system it describes | Vantage independence | "the system that writes the log is the system the log describes" | [source](http://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/32024R1689) (states the scope) |
| Probabilistic guardrail classifier on model input or output | Authorization | "a classifier outputs a probability under adversarial input, not a decision under a stated policy" | [source](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit/blob/6b644564d112b879e48183bc1655fcf73c86d23e/README.md) (states the scope) |
| Synchronous LLM monitor approving or flagging agent actions | Authorization | "the monitor blocks what a model scores above a risk threshold; a threshold on a model's score is a probability under adversarial input, not a decision under a stated policy (the same argument as mech:probabilistic-guardrail-classifier)" | [source](https://watcher.apolloresearch.ai/) (states the scope) |
| Conformance asserted by the implementer with no third-party check | Reader agreement | "ACS v0.1.0: nobody verifies a conformance claim; no suite, no registry, no steward" | [source](https://github.com/GenAI-Security-Project/agent-control-standard/blob/27799c2c27414a483a4a043b957bfd2997d53231/docs/spec/conformance.md) (states the limit) |

<a id="how-this-page-is-derived"></a>

## How this page is derived

Verdicts: `pass` is ESTABLISHED, `fail` is CONTRADICTED, and `not-exercised` and `out-of-scope` are NOT_ESTABLISHED, with out-of-scope results labelled. A verdict holds only at the record's evidence class.

Operation class, first match wins, from the record's own roles: **independently operated** only when `independentOperation` or `independentOperator` is exactly `established`; **Probity-operated** when an operator role (`runner`, `atlasOperator`, `fixtureOperator`, `historicalRunner`, `diagnosticRunner` or `atlasReplay`) names Probity; otherwise **author-operated**, where an operator role names the author of the fixture or software under test.

The page is regenerated by `python3 tools/gen_status.py`, and `python3 tools/build.py --check` fails when it is stale. Open cells come from `data/open-cells.toml`, written by `tools/export_open_cells.py`, which keeps a cell only when an excerpt of its source page was found there.
